_comment: DRAFT: the `tools` array to add to the .mcpb manifest.json (R4.1). name + description per tool, matching tool-reference.md. Smithery enumerates tools from here; keep in sync with the registered tools.

tools.name: page.info
tools.description: List the document's pages; with no args returns all pages, or pass pageIds to get those pages with their top-level children.

tools.name: node.info
tools.description: Read one or more nodes — recursive subtree traversal with fields selection, filter, and maxDepth. The workhorse read; start here before any write.

tools.name: node.transform
tools.description: Move and/or resize a node by setting absolute x/y/width/height (any subset).

tools.name: node.rename
tools.description: Rename a node.

tools.name: node.delete
tools.description: Delete one or more nodes in a single batched, per-item-validated call.

tools.name: node.clone
tools.description: Duplicate an existing node, optionally at a new position. Produces a new node id.

tools.name: node.select
tools.description: Set the canvas selection to one or more nodes and focus them in the viewport.

tools.name: node.group
tools.description: Wrap multiple nodes in a new group node.

tools.name: node.ungroup
tools.description: Dissolve a group, promoting its children to the parent.

tools.name: node.flatten
tools.description: Flatten a node and its children into a single vector.

tools.name: node.insert_child
tools.description: Reparent a node under a new parent at an optional index.

tools.name: node.set_auto_layout
tools.description: Configure a frame's auto-layout (mode, padding, spacing, alignment, sizing).

tools.name: node.set_fill
tools.description: Set a node's fill to a literal RGBA color. Use node.apply_style to link a shared paint style, or node.bind_variable to bind a color token.

tools.name: node.set_stroke
tools.description: Set a node's stroke color and weight; supports uniform or per-side weights.

tools.name: node.set_corner_radius
tools.description: Set a node's corner radius — uniform or per-corner.

tools.name: node.set_effects
tools.description: Set a node's effect array (shadows, blurs).

tools.name: node.apply_style
tools.description: Link a node to a shared library style (paint/text/effect/grid) by styleId.

tools.name: node.bind_variable
tools.description: Bind a variable to a node property, or set an explicit variable mode.

tools.name: node.export_visual
tools.description: Render a node to an image (PNG/JPG/SVG/PDF) at a given scale.

tools.name: create.shape
tools.description: Create a rectangle, ellipse, polygon, or star via type, with position/size and optional fill/stroke.

tools.name: create.frame
tools.description: Create a frame (container) with optional fill/stroke and full auto-layout configuration.

tools.name: create.text
tools.description: Create a text node with content and optional font size/weight/color.

tools.name: create.svg
tools.description: Create a node from an SVG markup string.

tools.name: create.component
tools.description: Convert an existing frame into a main component.

tools.name: create.instance
tools.description: Instantiate a component (by componentKey or componentId) at a position.

tools.name: create.component_set
tools.description: Combine components into a component set (variants) with property definitions.

tools.name: create.connection
tools.description: Create connector lines between nodes, or set/check the default connector template.

tools.name: style.list
tools.description: List all local styles (paint/text/effect/grid) in the document.

tools.name: style.manage
tools.description: Create a named style (paint/text/effect/grid), or update an existing one when styleId is given.

tools.name: text.set_content
tools.description: Set the text of one or more text nodes in a single batched, per-item-validated call.

tools.name: text.set_style
tools.description: Set any combination of typography properties (font, size, weight, spacing, decoration, …) on a text node.

tools.name: component.list
tools.description: List components in the document, with filtering and scope options.

tools.name: component.manage_property
tools.description: Add or edit a component-property definition (BOOLEAN/TEXT/INSTANCE_SWAP) on a main component or variant set.

tools.name: component.delete_property
tools.description: Remove a component-property definition from a main component or variant set; propagates to every instance.

tools.name: instance.set_property
tools.description: Set one property on an instance — boolean toggle, text override, instance swap, or variant selection.

tools.name: instance.get_overrides
tools.description: Read the override properties from a source instance, to later apply them to other instances.

tools.name: instance.set_overrides
tools.description: Apply previously-read overrides to target instances; targets are swapped to the source component.

tools.name: variable.list
tools.description: List local variables/collections, or detailed info for specific variable ids; optionally scan for consumers.

tools.name: variable.manage
tools.description: Create collections and variables and set their values/aliases.

tools.name: variable.delete
tools.description: Delete specific variables or an entire collection. Runs a full-document consumer check first and rejects if any target is still in use.

tools.name: annotation.list
tools.description: Read the native annotations on a node (and subtree); optionally include the file's annotation categories.

tools.name: annotation.set
tools.description: Create or update native annotations on one or more nodes in a batched call.

tools.name: reaction.list
tools.description: Read prototype reactions from one or more nodes. Process the output with the reaction_to_connector_strategy prompt to build create.connection parameters.

tools.name: reaction.update
tools.description: Replace a node's prototype reactions with a full new reactions array (read first via reaction.list).

tools.name: channel.join
tools.description: Join a plugin channel to establish the live connection to the Figma document.
